Welcome to the Omnia Lab wiki. This is the lab's shared knowledge base — if you find yourself explaining something for the second time, it probably belongs here.

## Contributing

Anyone in the lab can edit this wiki. See the [contributing guide](contributing.qmd) for how to add or update pages.
